title: Huang’s exit gives Nvidia rivals an opening in Israel
teaser: The resignation of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has unsettled Israel, which he called the company’s “second home.” Nvidia bought Israel’s Mellanox for $6.9 billion in 2019 and established the company’s largest research center outside the US there; it also planned to build a campus costing several billion dollars. Israeli investors are now watching to see whether Nvidia will maintain its commitment to the local economy, and whether the leadership change could give competitors an opening in AI accelerators and inference software.
